Each pair below has ONE true market price, quoted as units of the first currency per 1 unit of the second (e.g. SDG/ZAR = 345 means 345 SDG = 1 ZAR). The site derives BOTH directions from it automatically: first→second divides by marketPrice*(1+margin), second→first multiplies by marketPrice*(1-margin) — same margin percentage, worse than fair market both ways, exactly like a real buy/sell spread. Default margin is 3.5%, editable in /admin. ZAR-SAR, ZAR-QAR, ZAR-AED, ZAR-USDT, SDG-QAR, and SDG-AED are brand new corridors — their marketPrice values are rough cross-rate estimates only, verify and update every one in /admin before going live.
